# Women in Tech Network

> A global community platform celebrating and advancing women in technology through conferences, awards, memberships, and networking circles.

Women in Tech Network connects over 100,000 women across 145+ countries through annual flagship events, professional development programs, and recognition initiatives. The organization serves as a hub for diversity, leadership development, and career advancement in the tech industry.

## Key Topics

- Women in Tech Network
- Women in Tech Global Conference 2026
- WomenTech Awards
- Leadership recognition
- Diversity and inclusion
- Professional membership
- Networking circles
- Global ambassadors
- Career development
- Thought leadership
- Award categories
- Founding members
- Mentorship
- AI innovation
- Tech companies (Meta, Microsoft, IBM, Nvidia, Mozilla)

## Core Community

- [Women in Tech Global | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net): Homepage for Women in Tech Network community promoting diversity in tech
- [WomenTech Membership | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/about/womentech-membership): WomenTech membership overview with professional and founding member options
- [Women in Tech Professional Membership | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/memberships/professional-membership): Professional membership details with mentorship, networking, and conference access
- [WomenTech Founding Member | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/about/network-membership/womentech-founding-member): Founding member program with speaker, jury, and community leadership roles
- [Women in Tech Circles by WomenTech Network | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/circles): WomenTech Circles networking groups for mentorship and leadership development

## Global Conference

- [Women in Tech Global Conference 2026 Virtual-first | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/en-ca/women-tech-conference): Women in Tech Global Conference 2026 with 500+ speakers from 145+ countries
- [Why Attend the Women in Tech Conference - Virtual & Global | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/women-tech-conference/why-attend): Conference benefits including networking, leadership, and career development
- [Global Ambassadors: Women in Tech Global Conference | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/women-tech-conference/global-ambassadors): Global ambassador program for Women in Tech Global Conference 2026

## Awards & Recognition

- [Women in Tech Awards 2025 Virtual & Global - Celebrating 100 000 Women in Tech | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/women-tech-awards): Women in Tech Awards 2025 recognizing 100,000 women in tech globally
- [Global Awards Nomination | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/form/global-awards-nomination): Global Awards nomination form for multiple award categories and criteria
- [Categories: Women in Tech Awards Global Edition | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/women-in-tech-awards/categories): Women in Tech Awards 2025 categories including CIO, CMO, and leadership
- [Global Awards Winners 2025 | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/women-tech-awards/winners/2025): Women in Tech Global Awards 2025 winners from major tech organizations
- [Nominations: WomenTech Global Awards 2025 | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/women-tech-awards/nominees/2025): WomenTech Global Awards 2025 nominees for female founders and tech leaders
- [Global Awards Finalists 2025 | Women in Tech Network](https://www.womentech.net/women-tech-awards/finalists/2025): Women in Tech Global Awards 2025 finalists from major tech companies
